To get used to being the lead star, 
Transcend volunteered to take the 
leadership role at every turn, but before 
she knew it, she ended up working behind 
the scenes.

As an even more drastic measure, she 
decides to take on the lead role in the 
play at the Holy Hoof Festival.

However, her fellow dirt runners Espoir 
City and Furioso went wild during the 
dress rehearsal. Transcend, who was 
supposed to be the star, ended up playing 
peacemaker instead...

Transcend's struggles continue. Even so, 
step by step, she climbed the stairs to 
becoming the star.
